title: Correct Moon mass
description: Essential: Final answer for part (1) must be M = 4π²(R+h)³/(GT²).

title: Correct surface gravity
description: Essential: Final answer for part (2) must be g = 4π²(R+h)³/(T²R²).

title: Orbital force balance
description: Important: Applies Newton's law of gravitation equals centripetal force for the circular orbit.

title: Correct orbital radius
description: Important: Uses R+h as the orbital radius from Moon's center, not just h.

title: Derivation of surface g
description: Important: Correctly substitutes M into g = GM/R² to obtain final expression.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Shows dimensional analysis or mentions units for M and g.

title: Wrong radius usage
description: Pitfall: Uses h instead of R+h as orbital radius, or uses R instead of R+h.

title: Algebraic error
description: Pitfall: Makes algebraic mistake when solving for M or substituting into g formula.
